title: threadlight-loadtest manifest
description: Emitted by threadlight-loadtest (scripts/loadtest.py) after a budget-capped, guarded load-generation run. Extends the shared envelope from skills/_shared/manifest.py (schema, tool_version, generated_at, freshness, status, findings) with loadtest-specific payload fields. Contains no access tokens, prompts, model responses, request/response payloads, or endpoint secrets — only a boolean 'endpoint_configured', an adapter name, aggregate numeric diagnostics, and a scrubbed adapter error summary (if any). 'spec_update_plan' is present only for a complete run and is omitted entirely (never null) for partial/aborted runs.

findings.description: Exactly one finding for each of LOAD-001, LOAD-002, LOAD-003 — no duplicates, no missing, no unknown ids.

endpoint_configured.description: True only when the profile declared BOTH an endpoint URL and a credential reference NAME. The URL, the credential reference, and any secret material are never echoed into the manifest.

adapter_name.description: Name of the selected load-generation engine ('k6', 'locust', or an injected test adapter's name). Null when no adapter was selected/available.

projected_usd.description: Projected token cost of the run in USD. Null only when projection_source is 'unavailable'.

within_ceiling.description: Whether the projection is within the ceiling. Null only when projection_source is 'unavailable'.

projection_source.description: 'declared' = profile's explicit projected_token_cost_usd; 'derived' = deterministically computed from explicit request/rate + token-rate inputs; 'unavailable' = could not be determined without inventing inputs (projected_usd and within_ceiling are null).

diagnostics.description: Aggregate numbers only — never individual request/response bodies, prompts, or completions.

adapter_error.description: Scrubbed, truncated summary of an adapter-side failure. Never raw command stdout/stderr.

spec_update_plan.description: Advisory-only patch plan for a COMPLETE run. Never applied automatically — always a proposal for a human to review and apply to SPEC.md. Omitted entirely (never null) for partial/aborted runs.
